newsitem.title: USA: PHLX to list Omnipoint options Nov 11.
newsitem.headline: PHLX to list Omnipoint options Nov 11.

text.p: The Philadelphia Stock Exchange said Wednesday it would list options on shares of Omnipoint Corp on November 11.
The exchange said the options would have opening strike prices of 25, 30 and 35, with initial expirations in December, January, February and May.
Omnipoint shares were up 1/2 at 28-3/4 Wednesday morning.
TFM Investment Group will be the specialist unit.
The Chicago Board Options Exchange and the American Stock Exchange will also list Omnipoint options on November 11. -Derivatives desk, 312-408-8750/E-mail: derivatives@reuters.com
